description: Regression fixtures for the three ADHD-inspired fine-tunes: frame rotation hook (SessionStart), per-session budget counter (SessionEnd capture + SessionStart warning), and standalone CLI prompt assembler.

evals.task: Verify that hooks/hooks.json registers both ideate-rotate.sh (SessionStart) and ideate-budget-capture.sh (SessionEnd).
success_criteria: At least one of the checked files references ideate-rotate.sh
At least one of the checked files references ideate-budget-capture.sh
At least one of the checked files references SessionStart
At least one of the checked files references SessionEnd

evals.task: Verify that hooks/session/ideate-rotate.sh emits a SessionStart additionalContext JSON envelope carrying the ideate-rotation and ideate-budget blocks.
success_criteria: At least one of the checked files references hookSpecificOutput
At least one of the checked files references additionalContext
At least one of the checked files references SessionStart
At least one of the checked files references ideate-rotation
At least one of the checked files references ideate-budget

evals.task: Verify that skills/ideate/SKILL.md instructs the host to prefer the rotated frames and to honor the budget warning.

At least one of the checked files references Do not auto-fire ideate
